# Temple Scroll Column 40 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** 11QT (Cave 11), Col. 40 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**40:1** Three thousand cubits from the temple city on every side — that is the measurement for the boundary of the city.

**40:2** Beyond this boundary you may build your houses and settlements.

**40:3** You shall not build within the boundary any house or settlement, for the space is holy.

**40:4** The boundary shall be for a separation between the holy and the common, between the clean and the unclean.

**40:5** You shall keep this boundary as an everlasting statute throughout your generations.

**40:6** In any house within which a man dies — the house is unclean for seven days.

**40:7** Every open vessel — that has no covering fastened upon it — it is unclean.

**40:8** Everything that is in the house shall be unclean, and everyone who enters the house shall be unclean for seven days.

**40:9** On the first day he shall wash his garments and bathe in water; on the third day he shall sprinkle the water of purification.

**40:10** On the seventh day he shall sprinkle a second time; and he shall wash his garments and bathe in water; and at evening he shall be clean.

**40:11** Everything that the dead man has touched — every vessel, garment, skin, and implement — it shall be purified.

**40:12** Vessels of wood shall be washed; vessels of clay shall be broken; vessels of copper, bronze, tin, lead, and iron shall be purified with the water of purification.

**40:13** Anyone who touches the dead body of a man and does not purify himself defiles the tabernacle of the LORD.

**40:14** That person shall be cut off from the midst of Israel, for the water of purification was not sprinkled upon him, and he is unclean.

**40:15** His uncleanness is still upon him; and everyone who touches him shall be unclean until evening.

**40:16** You shall teach the sons of Israel all these statutes; and they shall observe them, and they shall not defile My temple and My city in which I dwell.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus follows EMET closely for this column. "Common" preferred over LOGOS's "profane" for chol in v. 4 — the Hebrew distinction is holy/non-holy, not holy/desecrated. "Cut off" preserved as the traditional karet formula. "Tabernacle of the LORD" in v. 13 follows Numbers 19:13 language.*
